Document: Education is the process of gaining knowledge, skills, and values. It helps students develop critical thinking, communication, and problem-solving abilities. Education plays an important role in personal growth and career development.

Educational technology improves the learning
experience through digital tools and applications.
Smart boards, educational videos, and online
platforms help students understand complex topics
and learn more effectively.

Student assessment is an important part of
education. Tests, assignments, and projects help
teachers evaluate student performance and
identify areas where students need improvement.

Traditional classroom learning allows students
to interact directly with teachers and classmates.
It encourages teamwork, communication, discipline,
and active participation in educational activities.

Inclusive education ensures that all students
get equal learning opportunities. It supports
students with different learning needs and
encourages respect, participation, and equality.
